svg.font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: The most ambitious BenBen loop we know is buildable
svg.desc: Top row, one run: a question, a Muse Spark workflow plan, route and checkpoints, BenBen driving, sensing, perception and triage, then human review and action. Bottom row, every run: the run archive feeds a virtual twin, place memory, a world map, replay evaluations and a navigation policy that is promoted only if it beats the current one. Dots mark what ran on Nov 4, what is wired and what is roadmap.

text.font-family: 'Chalkboard SE', 'Marker Felt', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The most ambitious loop we know is buildable
BenBen answers one route question with evidence, then every run makes the next answer better.
ONLINE PATH · ONE RUN · LEFT TO RIGHT
MEMORY AND LEARNING · EVERY RUN · RIGHT TO LEFT
